description.value:
Once in a while, the Teratoma would like to wear you for a minute.

Gift — Once per day, invite it fully: for 1 round, act with the Teratoma's own reflexes — reroll any one attack roll, skill check, or saving throw you just made and take the better result. Tithe — Once per session, the GM may decide the Teratoma didn't wait to be invited. It takes one full turn — your actions, your movement, spent on whatever it wants — and you are simply present for it. No save.
